title: Toward Localizing and Repairing Bias in Transformer Attention Heads

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the WinoBias gap by comparing the model's confidence in resolving gendered pronouns (he/she) to professions in stereotype-aligned versus anti-stereotype sentences, as well as evaluating model preference for stereotype sentences in the StereoSet benchmark.
